title: [finding] 8 dead ADR -> source-tree links in ADR-0004 and ADR-0020 — targets left this repository, and they are what forces #6592's gate to ship with a baseline
body:
Found while implementing #6592 (the `docs/adr/` link gate). Out of that card's scope — its dispatch explicitly bars editing `docs/adr/` this round (a sibling agent is in that directory for #6634) — so filed per Prime Directive #10.

## Fact

Two decision records carry 8 relative links into the source tree whose targets do not exist. Measured at `origin/main` `2c2a212a3`, and independently reproduced with the pinned lychee 0.24.2 (`lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2`) over `docs/adr/**/*.md`:

```
[docs/adr/0004-cloud-multi-kernel.md]:
[ERROR] .../apps/studio/src/routes/projects.$projectId.index.tsx (at 94:19) | File not found
[ERROR] .../apps/studio/src/routes/projects.index.tsx            (at 93:17) | File not found
[ERROR] .../packages/runtime/src/kernel-manager.ts               (at 67:24) | File not found
[ERROR] .../packages/runtime/src/project-kernel-factory.ts       (at 68:38) | File not found

[docs/adr/0020-state-machine-converge-and-enforce.md]:
[ERROR] .../examples/app-crm/src/flows/high-value-deal.flow.ts             (at 138:240) | File not found
[ERROR] .../examples/app-crm/src/flows/stale-opportunity.flow.ts          (at 138:327) | File not found
[ERROR] .../examples/app-crm/src/workflows/stale-opportunity.workflow.ts  (at  48:108) | File not found
[ERROR] .../packages/spec/src/contracts/workflow-service.ts               (at  43:23)  | File not found
```

All 8 are prose links, not illustrative examples: each is written as the reader's way to go look at the implementation the record is describing (`**KernelManager** ([...](../../packages/runtime/src/kernel-manager.ts)): LRU+TTL cache of ...`).

## Why each is ambiguous rather than a filename typo

None is a near-miss that a rename would fix, so #6592 did not guess:

- `apps/studio/**` — `apps/` in this repository now contains only `docs/`. Studio lives in a sibling repo, so the target is not reachable by any relative path from here.
- `packages/runtime/src/kernel-manager.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/project-kernel-factory.ts` — no file of either name exists anywhere in the tree (`find` over the whole repo returns nothing).
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/workflow-service.ts` — no `workflow-service*` under `packages/spec/src`.
- `examples/app-crm/src/workflows/` — the directory does not exist; `examples/app-crm/src/` has `flows/` but not these two files.

So the fix is a decision per link, not a sweep: repoint at wherever the code went, replace the link with a plain (unlinked) path, or drop the reference because the code left this repo. That is ADR-editing work and wants an author who can say which.

## Why it matters now

PR for #6592 lands `scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`, and these 8 are frozen individually on its `KNOWN_DEAD_TARGETS` shrink-only baseline so the gate can be green on arrival instead of red on every PR from day one. The baseline is shrink-only and enforced in both directions: fixing a link here makes its baseline entry fail as **stale**, so whoever fixes the record must delete the entry in the same change — the gate names each one for you.

Note the direction of the pressure: this is the only reason the gate ships with a baseline at all. The ADR-to-ADR surface (the class #6592 was filed for) is completely clean today — 527 relative destinations under `docs/adr/` resolve, 0 cross-record breaks, after #6593 fixed ADR-0057's.

## Severity

Observation-class as filed: no user path, no runtime behaviour. The cost is agent navigation — PD #13 sends the next author to go read the decision, the decision points at a file, the file is not there. Labelled `finding`, no `pm:queue`; severity is the PM's to grade.
